div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
智慧港口 / 车企车间 / CBD 超高层 5G-A 专网规划与投标演示
(需兼顾 ±1.2dB 场强精度、60fps 现场调参交互与秒级投标成片)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 仿真与可视化架构选择？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
无视金属集装箱与 Low-E 玻璃幕墙 28dB 损耗
场强误差 ±11.8 dB，导致 AGV 掉线急停

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
画出穿透 6 层实心钢板的假激光波束
无物理场强依据，在评标现场被客户总工否决

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 1: 导入港口/车间 3D BIM 并绑定 ITU-R P.2040 材质
精确建模钢板全反射 (R=0.96) 与 Low-E 玻璃穿透损耗

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 2: WebGPU BVH 60fps 实时弹跳射线 (SBR + UTD 劈尖绕射)
拖动天线倾角滑块 16.2ms 实时重算三维 RSRP (±1.2 dB)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 3: 64T64R 迫零波束赋形 + AGV 轨迹 CoMP 双站冗余门禁
确保工业控制 99.999% URLLC 零断联

span.p:
Stage 4: 14s Remotion 自动合成 4K 政企专网 SLA 投标视频
